Class TribeStatusDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.DTO.TribeStatusDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TribeStatusDTO extends Object implements Serializable
Data Transfer Object representing the current state of a Player's Tribe.

This DTO is designed to be consumed by the View. It provides:

  • Unique identifiers (DTOs) for cards to allow the View to retrieve assets (images/descriptions).
  • Pre-calculated totals to prevent the View from executing game logic.
  • A structured layout to easily render character columns and a building column.

      public TribeStatusDTO(LinkedHashMap<String, List<CardDTO>> charactersByColumn, List<CardDTO> buildingIds, int totalPrestigePoints, int currentFood, int totalSustenanceDiscount, int totalBuildingsFoodDiscount, int shamanStars, boolean extraCardFromUpper, boolean extraFoodFromBonus)
      Constructs a new TribeStatusDTO.
      Parameters:
      charactersByColumn - Ordered map of character types to their respective Card DTOs.
      buildingIds - List of all building Card DTOs.
      totalPrestigePoints - Total points calculated from buildings and characters.
      currentFood - The current amount of food available to the player.
      totalSustenanceDiscount - Total food discount for sustenance event.
      totalBuildingsFoodDiscount - Total food discount for buying buildings.
      shamanStars - Total count of shaman stars accumulated.
      extraCardFromUpper - True if the tribe can choose an extra card from the upper row.
      extraFoodFromBonus - True if positive turn order bonuses grant one additional food.
